#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int base, num;
    cin >> base >> num;
    vector<int> digits(101, 0);

    for (int i = 0; i <= 100; i++) {
        digits[i] = num % base;
        num /= base;
    }

    int carry = 0;
    bool result = true;
    for (int i = 0; i <= 100; i++) {
        digits[i] += carry;
        carry = digits[i] / base;
        digits[i] %= base;

        if (digits[i] == 0 || digits[i] == 1) {
            continue;
        } else if (digits[i] == base - 1) {
            carry = 1;
        } else {
            result = false;
            break;
        }
    }

    cout << ((result && carry != 1) ? "YES" : "NO");
    return 0;
}
